content:
devon_support: Urgent escalation — OrionHealth trial is blocked on SSO token exchange; seeing 502 from our token proxy and IdP reply says invalid_metadata. Renewal in 12 days; customer is flagged high-risk in Gainsight.
amy_cs: Thanks Devon. Can you paste the token proxy logs and confirm whether this started after yesterday's deploy?
devon_support: quick logs below:
```
2026-03-22T14:11:02Z token-proxy ERROR 502 GET /oauth/callback id=orion-123 trace=abc123
2026-03-22T14:11:03Z token-proxy WARN idp-response="invalid_metadata"
```
Not from deploys (no deploys in last 24h), looks like IdP changed metadata.
raj_cs_manager: assigning to CS: @amy_cs lead, @lina_enablement to do onboarding sync. Amy, propose 3-step comms plan by EOD.
amy_cs: ACK. I'll do a triage call with customer at 10:30 PT tomorrow, then handoff to enablement for SAML reconfigure. Draft comms:
- ASAP outbound: acknowledge, ETA for triage (10:30 PT)
- Post-triage: summary + action items + expected recovery window
- Pre-renewal check-in: confirm resolution and share mitigation playbook
lina_enablement: I'll prepare an SSO checklist and short walkthrough (15m). Can we get IdP metadata and an admin contact?
devon_support: customer admin is maya@orionhealth.com. I sent a connector export and metadata.xml to them. Also adding SAML error map:
```
invalid_metadata -> missing x509 cert | idp endpoint mismatch
```
oncall_eng: @devon_support @amy_cs if we need runtime changes, I'll be on-call 09:00-18:00 PT tomorrow. We should capture a packet of failing requests; enable debug flag on proxy: `TOKEN_PROXY_DEBUG=true` for 30m.
amy_cs: Plan: 1) triage call tomorrow 10:30 PT (me + devon + lina), 2) apply quick fixes (IdP metadata or proxy config), 3) follow-up comms + renewal flag cleared if resolved. I'll draft the customer note now and post to thread.
raj_cs_manager: add CS playbook tag 'sso-urgent-onboard' and flag renewal team. Great work. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
sre_bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-0456 assigned to token-proxy team.
devon_support: noted. I'll capture debug logs during the triage and share.
amy_cs: Draft note to customer posted to thread, small ask: CC renewal manager if resolution extends past 48h. Posting now.
amy_cs: "Maya — we see an invalid_metadata response from your IdP. Can we confirm you recently rotated certificates or updated endpoints? We're scheduling a 10:30 PT triage call tomorrow to fix this quickly. — Amy, Redwood CS"
lina_enablement: prepping the short SAML walkthrough. will attach slides and test commands.
raj_cs_manager: timeline check — if unresolved by 48h, schedule an executive touchpoint. Otherwise standard renewal cadence.
devon_support: capturing logs now, will upload trace abc123 to S3 and share link.
amy_cs: thanks. I'll set a reminder and update Gainsight. keeping this thread as single source of truth. :sparkles:
